entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: fortunes, fortunes_ef #64565
  • Enable dynamically reconfiguring routes after startup (asyncronously) [like YARP] #64563
  • Incorrect mapping of FileContentHttpResult and FileContentHttpResult in OpenAPI #64561
  • Bug: Unable to ignore Request Content-Length for RTSP-over-HTTP to allow reading a HTTP POST until the socket closes or dies #64555
  • Blazor Activity links on global render vs per-page rendermode are totally different #64554

Closed

  • OpenAPI Versioning: NullReferenceException in Transformer - metadata was null #64553
  • Isolated CSS Files are not applied, unable to restore behaviour that originally worked with CSS files #64390
  • Reporting Problem: .net core 9 blazor wasm project VS 22 throws Exception of type 'System.ExecutionEngineException' was thrown. #64441
